codex.habitat: Topsoil and the first few metres of root cover. Never seen below 70 m.
codex.behaviour: Forages in small groups. Bolts the instant it is noticed, then circles back out of curiosity.
codex.diet: Root fibre, fungal crumbs, and anything a digger leaves behind.
codex.resource: Its coat sheds usable root fibre. Harmless to take.
codex.weakness: None worth noting. It simply runs.
codex.lore: The most common life in the Rootlands, and the only one that seems entirely at ease here. Whatever changed the deep strata has not reached it yet.

variants.note: Older specimens are slowly overgrown by the moss they eat.
Born underground and never surfaced. The eye is almost blind.
